steps.title: Autoclave equipment and tools
steps.instruction: Autoclave all glassware, pipette tips, tubes, solutions, and surgical tools before use; perform all surgeries under aseptic conditions and obtain IACUC and biosafety approvals.

steps.title: Isolate zebra finch genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from zebra finch tissue (e.g., brain) using the QIAGEN Genomic DNA Isolation Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: PCR‑amplify miR‑9 gene
steps.instruction: Amplify the miR‑9 gene from the isolated DNA with the supplied forward (NheI site) and reverse (AscI site) primers using PfuUltraII Fusion HS polymerase: 95 °C 10 s denature, 54 °C 25 s anneal, 72 °C 25 s extend, 40 cycles.

steps.title: Gel‑purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Run the PCR reaction on a 1.5 % agarose gel, excise the 290 bp band, and purify the fragment with the QIAGEN Gel Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Digest insert and vector
steps.instruction: Digest the purified PCR product with NheI and AscI at 37 °C for 2–3 h; separately digest the lentiviral vector with the same enzymes under identical conditions.

steps.title: Purify digested vector
steps.instruction: Separate the digested vector by agarose‑gel electrophoresis, excise the band, and purify using the QIAGEN Gel Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Ligate insert into vector
steps.instruction: Ligate the miR‑9 fragment into the vector at a 5:1 insert‑to‑vector molar ratio in 20 µl ligation buffer with T4 DNA ligase; incubate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Transform Stbl3 cells
steps.instruction: Introduce the ligation mixture into XL10 Gold Ultracompetent Stbl3 cells, plate on LB agar containing 100 mg ml⁻¹ ampicillin, and incubate at 32 °C for 20 h.

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony, inoculate 250 ml LB broth with ampicillin, and grow at 32 °C for 15–20 h.

steps.title: Purify plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Harvest the culture and isolate plasmid DNA using the QIAGEN EndoFree Plasmid Maxi Kit; resuspend in 10 mM Tris (pH 7.5), quantify with a Nanodrop, and verify by sequencing or NheI/AscI digestion.

steps.title: Prepare packaging plasmids
steps.instruction: Prepare psPAX2 and VSVG plasmids in the same way as above, using XL10 Gold Ultracompetent cells and growing the bacteria at 37 °C.

steps.title: Seed 293LTV cells for virus production
steps.instruction: Plate 3 × 10⁶ 293LTV cells per 10 cm dish (typically six dishes) in IMDM supplemented with 10 % FBS and antibiotics the day before transfection.

steps.title: Pre‑transfection medium change
steps.instruction: Replace 75 % of the medium with IMDM (no FBS) 2 h before transfection when cells are ~70 % confluent.

steps.title: Prepare calcium‑phosphate transfection mix
steps.instruction: Prepare Solution A (67 µg Lenti‑vector DNA, 50 µg psPAX2, 34 µg VSVG, 347.2 µl 2 M Ca²⁺, sterile H₂O to 2.8 ml) and Solution B (2.8 ml 2× HBS) in separate tubes; add Solution B to A dropwise while gently shaking to form the mix; let sit at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Add transfection mix to cells
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 1.4 ml of the transfection mixture to each 10 cm plate; incubate at 37 °C for 8–10 h.

steps.title: Replace medium post‑transfection
steps.instruction: Discard the calcium‑phosphate‑containing medium and replace with 8 ml IMDM containing 2 % FBS.

steps.title: Collect virus‑containing supernatant
steps.instruction: At 48 h post‑transfection, collect the medium, store at 4 °C, and replace with fresh 8 ml IMDM + 2 % FBS; repeat collection at 72 h and discard the cells.

steps.title: Clarify and filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Combine the two collections, centrifuge at 720 × g (2 000 rpm) for 10 min at 4 °C, transfer supernatant, and filter through a sterile 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge virus
steps.instruction: Spin the filtered supernatant at 82 700 r av g (25 000 rpm) for 2 h at 4 °C; discard supernatant, briefly rinse the pellet with PBS, and resuspend in 50–60 µl PBS at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Decontaminate waste
steps.instruction: Bleach all waste medium and plasticware before disposal.

steps.title: Titer lentiviral preparation
steps.instruction: Seed 293LTV cells in a 24‑well plate at 2 × 10⁴ cells/well in IMDM + 10 % FBS; after 24 h switch to IMDM + 2 % FBS. Make serial dilutions of the virus (10⁻¹ to 10⁻⁶) in IMDM, add 1 µl of each dilution to three wells per dilution, incubate 72 h, then count fluorescent cells. Calculate titer as (fluorescent cells × dilution factor). Typical titer: 2–3 × 10⁶ IU µl⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare juvenile finches for injection
steps.instruction: Remove the father at day 10, keep juveniles with their mothers until day 30; perform viral injection at 25 ± 1 days of age.

steps.title: Anesthetize birds
steps.instruction: Weigh each bird and inject intramuscularly 24 µg kg⁻¹ ketamine and 12 µg kg⁻¹ xylazine (dose per gram of body weight).

steps.title: Mount bird in stereotaxic apparatus
steps.instruction: Place the bird on the head‑holder with tail up 10°, tighten mouth and ear bars.

steps.title: Expose skull
steps.instruction: Disinfect scalp with iodine, pluck feathers, and cut a midline incision 1–1.2 cm long.

steps.title: Prepare glass injection needle
steps.instruction: Pull a glass needle with a needle puller, adjust heating dial to obtain an inner tip diameter of 25–30 µm.

steps.title: Spin virus before loading
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the virus solution 5 min at 9 300 × g (10 000 rpm) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Load injection needle
steps.instruction: Fill the needle sequentially with 1 µl mineral oil, 1–2 µl viral solution, and 0.5 µl mineral oil.

steps.title: Locate bregma and mark injection sites
steps.instruction: Mount the needle on the stereotaxic manipulator, move to bregma, record AP and ML coordinates, then move to the midpoint above Area X and mark the site.

steps.title: Create skull window
steps.instruction: Drill a 1–1.5 mm² opening at the marked site with a 25 G syringe needle; pierce the dura with a 25 G needle.

steps.title: Inject virus into Area X
steps.instruction: Inject at 6 or 8 sites per hemisphere (bilateral for behavior) using coordinates: AP 2.8 mm & 3.2 mm, ML 1.3 mm & 1.5 mm, DV 4.2 mm & 4.4 mm (from skull surface). Deliver 120 nl per site over 2 min with a hydraulic pressure device; keep the needle in place 2 min before and 5 min after injection.

steps.title: Close surgical site
steps.instruction: Replace the skull bone fragment, close the skin (overlapping edges), and seal with Vetbond.

steps.title: Recover bird post‑surgery
steps.instruction: Place the bird on a thermal pad at 30 °C until it awakens (~30 min), then return it to its home cage.

steps.title: Post‑surgical decontamination
steps.instruction: Disinfect the surgery area with 70 % ethanol, bleach injection needles, autoclave surgical tools, and dispose of sharps in a designated container.

steps.title: Record injection metadata
steps.instruction: Log injection date, animal ID, viral agent, coordinates, and injected volume.

steps.title: Rear injected juveniles
steps.instruction: Keep juveniles with mothers until day 30; from day 30 to 70 house each bird with an adult male tutor in a sound‑attenuated chamber.

steps.title: Record undirected songs
steps.instruction: Record each juvenile’s undirected song for two days, 8 AM–12 PM; sort files and discard cage noise manually or with SAP.

steps.title: Select representative song files
steps.instruction: From the sorted files, choose 20 pupil song files evenly spaced (e.g., 1st, 11th, 21st, …) for analysis.

steps.title: Count syllables per motif
steps.instruction: Manually tally total syllables and total motifs in the 20 pupil files (50–80 motifs) and 10 tutor files (25–40 motifs); compute average syllables per motif for pupil and tutor, then compare.

steps.title: Identify missing syllables
steps.instruction: List syllable types (A, B, C, …) in pupil and tutor files; a syllable is ‘missing’ if absent in the pupil or its frequency in the pupil is <10 % of its frequency in the tutor.

steps.title: Motif similarity analysis
steps.instruction: Compare each of the 20 pupil motifs with each of the 10 tutor motifs (200 comparisons) using SAP’s default asymmetric time‑course mode; average the % similarity scores to obtain the overall motif similarity.

steps.title: Maximum motif similarity
steps.instruction: Rank the 200 similarity scores, select the top 10 (top 5 %), and average them to yield the maximum motif similarity score.

steps.title: Syllable accuracy analysis
steps.instruction: Measure accuracy for each syllable in 20 pupil renditions with SAP’s asymmetric mode; average across all syllables to obtain a pupil accuracy score.

steps.title: Syllable feature analysis
steps.instruction: For each syllable type, measure duration, mean frequency, goodness of pitch, frequency modulation, and Wiener entropy in 20 pupil and 10 tutor renditions using SAP; compute % difference relative to tutor ((pupil‑tutor)/tutor × 100) and average across syllable types.

steps.title: Syllable feature variation
steps.instruction: Calculate the coefficient of variation for each acoustic feature across the 20 renditions of a syllable; then average these coefficients across all syllable types.

steps.title: Syllable transition entropy
steps.instruction: Auto‑segment all songs (≈10 000–19 000 syllables), cluster syllables into types with SAP, validate clusters manually, build a transition matrix, compute relative transition probabilities (pₜ), calculate entropy per type (−∑pₜ log pₜ), weight each entropy by syllable frequency, and finally average weighted entropies across types to obtain overall transition entropy.

steps.title: Quantify total singing output
steps.instruction: Batch‑segment all song files recorded per bird (8 AM–12 PM, two days) with SAP and record the total number of syllables produced.

steps.title: Record female‑directed songs
steps.instruction: Manually record male songs directed at a female between 8 AM–11 AM; present one or two females in a nearby cage (change females every 10 min if needed).

steps.title: Constant fundamental frequency analysis
steps.instruction: Select 20–40 renditions of syllables containing a constant fundamental frequency (harmonic stacks) from both undirected and female‑directed contexts; measure the constant f₀ using SAP.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of behavior
steps.instruction: For each experiment use 6–8 birds per treatment, 10–20 motif renditions per bird; analyze data with t‑test, paired t‑test, ANOVA, and/or Mann‑Whitney test; consider results significant at P < 0.05.

steps.title: Prepare Solution A (calcium‑phosphate)
steps.instruction: Combine 67 µg Lenti‑vector plasmid DNA, 50 µg psPAX2, 34 µg VSVG, 347.2 µl 2 M Ca²⁺ solution, and sterile H₂O to a final volume of 2 800 µl.

steps.title: Prepare Solution B (2× HBS)
steps.instruction: Mix 2 800 µl 2× HBS solution.
